import time
import numpy as np
from tasks.t0052_minimal_dsgc_scalar_gaba.code.run_tuning_curve import setup_sweep_artifacts
from tasks.t0052_minimal_dsgc_scalar_gaba.code.constants import TrialMode, V_INIT_MV
from tasks.t0052_minimal_dsgc_scalar_gaba.code.trial import run_one_trial
artifacts = setup_sweep_artifacts()
from neuron import h
h.cvode.active(True)
soma = artifacts.cell.soma
ais = artifacts.cell.axon_initial_segment
# Boost soma gnabar moderately. Keep AIS at default.
soma.gnabar_hh = 0.3
print(f'soma defaults: gnabar={soma(0.5).hh.gnabar} gkbar={soma(0.5).hh.gkbar} gl={soma(0.5).hh.gl} el={soma(0.5).hh.el}')

v_rec = h.Vector()
v_rec.record(soma(0.5)._ref_v)
h.finitialize(V_INIT_MV)
h.continuerun(50.0)
v = np.array(list(v_rec))
print('quiescent v_final=', v[-1])

# Test all 4 conditions
for (mode, angle) in [(TrialMode.AMPA_ONLY, 0), (TrialMode.AMPA_ONLY, 180), (TrialMode.FULL, 0), (TrialMode.FULL, 180), (TrialMode.GABA_ONLY, 0), (TrialMode.GABA_ONLY, 180)]:
    t0 = time.time()
    res = run_one_trial(h=h, cell=artifacts.cell, pairs=artifacts.pairs, mode=mode, angle_deg=float(angle), trial_seed=1)
    print(f'{mode.value} {angle}: t={time.time()-t0:.2f}s n_spikes={len(res.spike_times_ms)} v_max={res.v_soma_mv.max():.2f} v_min={res.v_soma_mv.min():.2f}')
